content:
For mandate-based transfers, READY bank advice gives mandate_id, value_minute, amount, original payee and transmission reference. It does not give a present-day destination recommendation.

claims records signed assignments of a mandate to an account with inclusive valid_from_minute and valid_to_minute. DRAFT assignments do not convey title.

Entitlement follows the SIGNED assignment covering the bank value_minute, rather than the date on which a support investigation is performed. Future signed versions can coexist with the historic assignment.
